subject.title: fix(google): default web_search model to rolling alias, not retired gemini-2.5-flash

question: Should unconfigured Gemini web search deliberately follow Google's rolling `gemini-flash-latest` alias rather than pinning a specific supported grounding model?
rationale: This is a user-visible default change: it fixes a retired endpoint but delegates future model selection, capability, and cost changes to Google's alias lifecycle.

options.title: Adopt the rolling alias
options.body: Keep this implementation after live grounding proof confirms the alias works on the supported Generative Language API path.

options.title: Pin a stable grounding model
options.body: Replace the fallback with a currently supported fixed Gemini model if predictable model generation and pricing are preferred over automatic rollover.

recommendation.title: Adopt the rolling alias
recommendation.body: Keep this implementation after live grounding proof confirms the alias works on the supported Generative Language API path.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented the original failure and the same alias-based remedy in the linked prior proposal.
